sentence: O ceo non esta claro nesta manhã.
ipa: o ˈs̺ɛo ˈnɔ̃ ˈɛs̺tɐ ˈklaɾo ˈnɛs̺tɐ ˈmaɲã
gloss_en: The sky is not clear this morning.
notes: Deaffricated <c> before front vowel [ˈs̺ɛo] (Galaico-Portuguese /t͡s/ has collapsed to apico-alveolar [s̺]) and archaic negator <non> per maia1986; open-mid tonic [ɛ ɔ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A minha senhora mora perto do rio caudaloso.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ seˈɲɔɾɐ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈpɛɾto do ˈɾio kawdaˈlɔz̺o
gloss_en: My lady lives near the mighty river.
notes: Palatal <nh> [ɲ] and final-vowel reduction to [ɐ] (an Old-Portuguese innovation over Galaico-Portuguese) per maia1986; open/close-mid contrast per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Vai agora pela carreira do vale.
ipa: ˈvaj ɐˈɡɔɾɐ pelɐ kaˈrejɾɐ do ˈvale
gloss_en: Go now along the road of the valley.
notes: Trilled <rr> [r] in <carreira> and coda /l/ in <vale> per maia1986; <Vai agora> vowel liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O pescado do mar era saboroso e fresco.
ipa: o pes̺ˈkado do ˈmaɾ ˈɛɾɐ saboˈɾɔz̺o e ˈfɾɛs̺ko
gloss_en: The fish from the sea was tasty and fresh.
notes: Apico-alveolar [s̺] for <s> in coda and onset (no chiado yet) per maia1986; <saboroso e> liaison and open-mid [ɛ ɔ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Onde mora vossa madre nesta vila?
ipa: ˈɔ̃de ˈmɔɾɐ ˈvɔs̺ɐ ˈmadɾe ˈnɛs̺tɐ ˈvilɐ
gloss_en: Where does your mother live in this town?
notes: Archaic lexicon <madre> ('mother') and possessive <vossa> per cunha_cintra1984; final unstressed [ɐ] reduction per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Quantos dias durou a vossa viagem?
ipa: kwãˈtos̺ ˈdias̺ duˈɾow ɐ ˈvɔs̺ɐ viˈaʒẽ
gloss_en: How many days did your journey last?
notes: Retained <ou> diphthong [duˈɾow] per maia1986; <durou a> liaison and reduced final [ɐ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Se eu podesse, iria veer a rainha.
ipa: se ˈew poˈdɛs̺e iˈɾiɐ veˈɛɾ ɐ ˈɾajɲɐ
gloss_en: If I could, I would go to see the queen.
notes: Archaic hiatus infinitive <veer> [veˈɛɾ] and imperfect-subjunctive <podesse> per cunha_cintra1984; palatal <nh> in <rainha> per maia1986.

sentence: Comprei pão e vinho na feira grande.
ipa: kõˈpɾej ˈpɐ̃w̃ e ˈviɲo nɐ ˈfejɾɐ ˈɡɾãde
gloss_en: I bought bread and wine at the great fair.
notes: Nasal diphthong <ão> [ˈpɐ̃w̃] (fully phonemicised in Old Portuguese) per mateus_dandrade2000; retained <ei> and palatal <nh> per maia1986.

sentence: Amanhã irei pelo caminho da montanha.
ipa: ɐˈmaɲã iˈɾej pelo kaˈmiɲo dɐ mõˈtaɲɐ
gloss_en: Tomorrow I will go along the mountain path.
notes: Palatals <nh> [ɲ] and retained <ei> [iˈɾej] per maia1986; <Amanhã irei> liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Chamade o moço que traga o cavalo.
ipa: t͡ʃaˈmade o ˈmɔs̺o ke ˈtɾaɡɐ o kaˈvalo
gloss_en: Call the boy to bring the horse.
notes: Second-plural imperative <chamade> per cunha_cintra1984; deaffricated <ç> [ˈmɔs̺o] (former /t͡s/) per maia1986.

sentence: Boa manhã, senhora; como vos vai a saude?
ipa: ˈbɔɐ ˈmaɲã seˈɲɔɾɐ ˈkɔmo vos̺ ˈvaj ɐ ˈsawde
gloss_en: Good morning, lady; how does your health fare?
notes: Clitic address <vos> per cunha_cintra1984; palatal <nh>, open-mid [ɔ] and <vai a> liaison per maia1986.

sentence: Mais val bõo amigo que muito parente.
ipa: ˈmajs̺ ˈval ˈbõo ɐˈmiɡo ke ˈmujto paˈɾɛ̃te
gloss_en: A good friend is worth more than many kinsmen.
notes: Archaic nasal-hiatus <bõo> [ˈbõo] and apocopated <val> per cunha_cintra1984; coda /l/ per maia1986.

sentence: O gato negro dorme sob o banco velho.
ipa: o ˈɡato ˈnɛɡɾo ˈdɔɾme ˈsɔb o ˈbãko ˈvɛʎo
gloss_en: The black cat sleeps under the old bench.
notes: Open-mid [ɔ ɛ] and palatal <lh> [ˈvɛʎo] per maia1986; <sob o> junction per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Aquele rato fugiu para o buraco.
ipa: ɐˈkɛle ˈɾato fuˈʒiu ˈpaɾɐ o buˈɾako
gloss_en: That mouse fled into the hole.
notes: Final-vowel reduction to [ɐ] in <para> and <fugiu o> junction per mateus_dandrade2000; unreduced tonic per maia1986.

sentence: O mundo enteiro fala deste grande feito.
ipa: o ˈmũdo ẽˈtejɾo ˈfalɐ ˈdɛs̺te ˈɡɾãde ˈfejto
gloss_en: The whole world speaks of this great deed.
notes: Archaic <enteiro>/<feito> with retained <ei> per maia1986; final [ɐ] reduction and open-mid [ɛ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O sol luz sobre as colinas verdes.
ipa: o ˈsɔl ˈluz ˈsɔbɾe ɐs̺ koˈlinas̺ ˈvɛɾdes̺
gloss_en: The sun shines over the green hills.
notes: Coda /l/ [ˈsɔl] and apico-alveolar coda [s̺] (no chiado) per maia1986; <sobre as> liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A serra e alta e o rio corre forte.
ipa: ɐ ˈsɛrɐ e ˈɐltɐ e o ˈɾio ˈkɔre ˈfɔɾte
gloss_en: The mountain range is high and the river runs strong.
notes: Trilled <rr> [r] in <serra>/<corre> per maia1986; <serra e>/<e alta> liaison and open-mid [ɛ ɔ] per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: Minha filha colheu as flores no vale.
ipa: ˈmiɲɐ ˈfiʎɐ koˈʎew ɐs̺ ˈflɔɾes̺ no ˈvale
gloss_en: My daughter gathered the flowers in the valley.
notes: Palatals <nh>/<lh> [ɲ ʎ] and archaic hiatus <colheu> per maia1986; final [ɐ] reduction per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: A cidade tem muitas ruas e pontes.
ipa: ɐ s̺iˈdade ˈtɛ̃ ˈmujtas̺ ˈɾuas̺ e ˈpɔ̃tes̺
gloss_en: The city has many streets and bridges.
notes: Deaffricated <c> before front vowel [s̺iˈdade] (former /t͡s/) per maia1986; <ruas e> liaison per mateus_dandrade2000.

sentence: O coração da donzela era leal e nobre.
ipa: o koˈɾas̺ɐ̃w̃ dɐ dõˈzɛlɐ ˈɛɾɐ leˈal e ˈnɔbɾe
gloss_en: The maiden's heart was loyal and noble.
notes: Deaffricated <ç> before nasal diphthong [koˈɾas̺ɐ̃w̃] (Old-Portuguese /t͡s/>[s̺]) per maia1986; nasal diphthong <ão> and coda /l/ in <leal> per mateus_dandrade2000.
